#Blueface Shares Chrisean Rock’s Updated Face Tattoo Where She Added Logos Of Companies & Brands He Got Tatted While He Was In Prison 😭👀

Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Porter, is a 29-year-old rapper, entertainer, and internet personality from Los Angeles, California. He rose to fame in 2018 with his viral hit “Thotiana,” becoming one of the most recognizable names in West Coast hip-hop. Known for his unique offbeat rap flow, outspoken personality, and viral moments, Blueface has remained a major topic across social media. In recent years, he has expanded into livestreaming and reality entertainment, frequently making headlines for his personal life and relationships, particularly with Chrisean Rock and Jaidyn Alexis. 

Who Is Chrisean Rock?

Chrisean Rock, whose real name is Chrisean Eugenia Malone, is a 26-year-old rapper, reality television star, and social media personality from Baltimore, Maryland. She first gained attention through Blueface’s reality series Blue Girls Club before becoming a breakout personality on Zeus Network’s Baddies and Blueface & Chrisean: Crazy in Love. She has also pursued a music career, releasing songs such as “Vibe” and “Mr. Take Ya Bitch.” Chrisean shares a son, Chrisean Jr., with Blueface, and their highly publicized on-and-off relationship has generated countless viral moments. Despite their complicated history, the two have continued making headlines through their reunions, family moments, and social media appearances.
